answer: One defence is Jade carver drilled bead assay witnessed by the carvers hall: each drilled bead is a mine assay countersigned by the warden, so a farm must carve a hundred real jades by hand, and the pulse of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The wharf grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. The sable is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
